drive_sources.title: RAFAELIA — Ciclo 8 — Evidência Física com Nonce e Guest Boot — 2026-07-26
drive_sources.scope: transaction-specific closure design for Vectras -> Termux -> QEMU -> guest kernel -> guest userspace -> shutdown
implemented_contract: 32-byte SecureRandom nonce serialized to 64 hex characters
nonce bound to guest argv, canonical request, request SHA-256, append-only request and Termux receipt
ordered boot/userspace/shutdown guest markers sharing the same nonce
ADB no-root collector with Android/ABI identity, serial hash, fingerprint, boot ID and installed APK SHA-256
request/receipt collection via adb exec-out run-as
PASS_DEVICE_EVIDENCE_LIMITED requires request/receipt reconciliation, permission grant, non-truncated output, err=0 and exitCode=0
limitations: The 2026-07-26 workflow observed zero job steps and no logs.
No physical Vectras-to-Termux guest transaction was observed in this document.
